positions.name: DeploymentGateAsSettledRequirement
positions.frame: How is the deployment gate performed as a settled operational requirement rather than as a proposal still under debate?
positions.why: The directive (src-1) and the structured decision summary (src-3) both perform the gate as a decided, enforced precondition — one as mandate, the other as ratified record. They share decision-grade conviction, calm-positive affect, legitimate authority, and the conservation value of controlled deployment, cohering as a single directional read of the gate as settled procedure. src-2, the motivating-incident justification, carries claim-level conviction and a plain-spoken register departure that breaks this coherence; it stays ungrouped.
